interpolation: linear root translation/joint angles, quaternion SLERP; terminal source sample hold
reference_origin: fresh direct retarget of original 0623/0804_2 BVHs on exact G1 model; no legacy robot PKL/NPZ inputs
dataset_differences: same source captures and hit labels; G1-specific IK and hitting-point peak selection
root_height: preserve constrained G1 IK root trajectory; no clip-builder height adjustment
